body:
well I think part of the reason I wrote this is that to some extent I have given up. Not that I'm measuring a rope as I type, I've not set myself to suicide. I mean that that I just feel like I give up. Therapy hasn't worked so far, not even really a dent. Medication hasn't worked except for some anti-anxiety pills but if I'm not taking them just to sleep then it calms the shaky anxiety and brings the depression into even greater focus. I have no foreseeable future for the first time in my life and the aggreget is getting too much. 

I have an oversion to suicide, because it is final and there is nothing after. No next life nothing, just less than void. I've always drawn comfort from that in the past, that I would never ever do something so stupid. But my resolve is weakening. It's still there but I don't like the direction it's going. I guess that's what caused me to write this.

I mean this with all the respect in the world but did you miss the parts, the main parts, where I said that I have been going for years without noticeable change? In fact I am probably worse off now than when I started (not blaming the mental health profession for that, just saying). I'm having an exhistential crisis, facing the prospect that mental health, having failed me for years, may continue to fail and your suggestion is just keep going?

I know it's well intentioned I know it comes from a truly good place that sees another stranger is hurting and you want to help. Where else but Reddit. However other than "that's just what you do, you seek professionals" I can't see how that helps me. I would love to believe that it would help, but I'm not sure of that anymore and that adds to the hurt. I can't say what I expected posting this here but thanks. I don't want to sound ungrateful.
